name: GitHub Copilot Fusion
desc: A model picker entry that routes one task across several models.
desc_zh: 模型选择器里的一个选项，把一个任务分派给多个模型协作。
solves: Picking one model means paying for the strongest on every step. Fusion chooses single, cascade or critique based on the task, and escalates only when the quality gate fails.
solves_zh: 只选一个模型，等于每一步都按最强的付费。Fusion 按任务选择单模型、级联或评议三种流程，只在质量关口没过时才升级。
best_for: You want good output without hand-picking a model for each step.
best_for_zh: 你想拿到好结果，又不想一步步手挑模型。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — GitHub Changelog, https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-route-and-orchest）。 Appears in the model picker rather than being a model itself. Expanded availability and benchmarks followed on 2026-11-17. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：2026-09-30 的研究预览 HydraFusion（VS Code 与 Copilot 应用里的多模型编排）与这项能力是同一件事的早期名字，未单独入库。 首次公开日期来源：https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-28-route-and-orchestrate-models-with-github-copilot-fusion/
